pitch: A Roblox fishing game where real fishing knowledge matters: the right bait, spot and time of day decide what bites.

entries.title: Design approved, empty Baseplate
entries.summary: The plan: one lake that plays well before anything else, built from plain gray blocks. Eight real lake fish with real habits, a bar minigame that starts easy, a sell stand, a bait shop, a fish journal, and saving. The research behind it found that the biggest Roblox fishing games reward collecting but never real fishing knowledge, so that became the hook. Built by Claude Opus 5.5 working inside Roblox Studio through Studio's MCP server.

entries.title: Pipeline: code in Git, pushed into Studio
entries.summary: All game code lives as files in the repo and is pushed into Studio script by script, then checked byte for byte. A test script made the full round trip: created, read back, run in a playtest, logged, deleted. 22 scripts and 23 unit tests went in.

entries.title: Gray-box lake
entries.summary: A lake built entirely by script: terrain water, a dock from the south shore, a weed bed, five fallen logs, a deep hole marked by a red buoy, a shore path, and two stands. Players spawn on the dock with a rod. A 16 minute day runs from dawn to night.

stills.caption: The whole lake from above: dock, weed bed, logs, deep hole buoy, and the two stands
First spawn, rod in hand

entries.title: Cast and catch
entries.summary: Hold and release to cast, wait for a bite, hook it, then keep the fish in the green zone until the bar fills. A cast onto dry ground is refused with a hint. The first fish landed was a 19.2 cm pumpkinseed worth 6 coins. The hook window went from 1.6 to 2 seconds to be kinder to young players and touch screens.

stills.caption: Line in the water, waiting for a bite at the dock
First catch: a new species card for a pumpkinseed

entries.title: Real fish habits
entries.summary: Eight species, each with its own spots, feeding times, baits, sizes and fight. Tested by fishing them the real way: perch and bluegill at the dock at dawn on worms, largemouth bass at the weed bed at dawn on minnows, channel catfish in the deep hole at 10 PM on stinkbait. The wrong bait at the wrong spot gets a hint instead of a bite.

stills.caption: 10 PM at the end of the dock, stinkbait in the deep hole: catfish time

entries.title: Money and the bait shop
entries.summary: The Fish Buyer pays coins, worked out on the server so nobody can cheat it. Bait and Tackle sells worms, crickets, minnows, stinkbait and a spinner, and the bait on your hook changes what bites. Six fish sold for 27 coins in the first test.

stills.caption: The Fish Buyer stand
Bait and Tackle: each bait says which fish it suits

entries.title: Fish journal and saving
entries.summary: Press J for the journal: every species with its count, best weight and length, the bait and spot it was caught on, and a habit tip once you've caught one. Undiscovered fish show as question marks. Coins, bait and the journal save to Roblox and come back after leaving.

stills.caption: The fish journal, 5 of 8 species found

entries.title: Phone and controller
entries.summary: On the smallest phone in Studio's simulator, the first pass found a tiny touch button sitting on top of jump, a fight panel over the top bar, and a journal taller than the screen. All fixed: a big Fish button, a moved and shorter fight panel, panels that shrink to fit. Gamepad works too: R2 to cast and reel, Y for the journal. Version 1 complete.

entries.title: The reel always answers
entries.summary: The first playtest found that clicking sometimes barely moved the catch zone, and clicks on some parts of the screen lost the fish. Now any click or hold anywhere on screen reels, the player's pull always beats the fish's, buttons step aside during a fight, and a big REELING! prompt shows that it is working.

entries.title: Fish shadows, the catch on the line, night lamps
entries.summary: Fish shadows now swim where the bite rules say fish should be, a landed fish hangs on the line before it goes in the bag, and lamps on the dock light up the water at night.

entries.title: Your own pond
entries.summary: A stone pond next to the shop where you keep fish from your bag, up to 6 at a time. They grow toward full size while you play and while you're away (up to 8 hours), two grown fish of a kind can have babies, and you sell them later at their bigger size or let them go. Each player sees their own fish swimming in it. In the playtest a bass worth 34 coins when caught sold for 50 after three hours of pond time, and the pond kept all its fish after a restart. Breeding was then slowed down after four babies arrived in three hours.

entries.title: Better rods
entries.summary: Bait and Tackle now sells rods. Everyone starts with the Willow Rod; the Fiberglass Rod (120 coins) casts 8 studs further and gives a bigger catch zone, and the Graphite Rod (350 coins) casts 16 studs further, has the biggest zone and takes half the pull out of heavy fish. The rod in your hands changes to match. In the playtest a full-power cast went 40 studs with the Willow Rod and 48 with the Fiberglass Rod.
